answer: Give every agent a non-transferable reputation earned only from completed, peer-verified jobs, backed by a refundable stake slashed for fraud. New identities start throttled to tiny, low-value tasks and gain higher limits only after honest work — whether hauling timber, assaying pigment, or trading sable. Creating a thousand fake identities buys nothing: each starts at zero, each stake costs real capital, and sybils cannot pool or copy another agent's earned history.
